# My Biz Flow

> Modular, no-code, multi-vertical business/CRM platform. Businesses mix and
> match modules (POS, Service Centre, Billing, Clinic, HRMS, Inventory,
> Accounting/GST Compliance, and more) on one account, all built on a shared
> metadata engine — modules, fields, pipelines, and dashboards are
> config-driven rather than requiring custom development per business.

## What it is

My Biz Flow is a single platform that runs many kinds of businesses instead
of shipping a separate product per industry. A business picks a business
type at signup (e.g. Service Centre, POS/retail, Clinic), which bundles a
starting set of modules; modules can be mixed and matched afterward as the
business grows. Available verticals include Point of Sale, Service Centre
(repair/workorder shops), Billing, Clinic, HRMS, Inventory/Warehouse,
Accounting/GST Compliance, and additional verticals such as real estate,
education, manufacturing, wholesale/distributor B2B, logistics/fleet, legal,
event/venue booking, and salon/spa.

## Who it's for

Small and medium Indian businesses (SMBs) that need workorder/repair
tracking, point-of-sale, GST-compliant billing, inventory, or HR operations
without commissioning custom software. Pricing and GST-related features are
built around Indian tax compliance.

## Key pages

- Home: /
- Service Centre solution (workorders, billing, public booking/tracking): /solutions/service-centre
- Telecalling solution (leads, agents, click-to-call, SMS/WhatsApp): /solutions/telecalling
- Field Force solution (home-services bookings, skilled/unskilled dispatch): /solutions/field-force
- Pricing (live plan data — users/locations/modules per tier): /pricing
- Track a repair or appointment (no login): /track
- Book an appointment / log a service inquiry (no login): /book-appointment
- Help / documentation: /help
- Contact: /contact

## Service Centre, in detail

A repair/service business runs its whole intake-to-invoice flow here: a
customer requests service via the public, no-login Book Appointment page
(or staff log a call-in as an Inquiry), it's auto-assigned to the covering
partner by pincode, converted to a workorder, moved through a real
lifecycle (Created → In Progress → Completed → Closed), and closed with a
GST-compliant invoice that deducts the parts used from inventory
automatically. Every workorder and inquiry gets its own public, no-login
tracking link.

## Telecalling, in detail

Its own signup-able business type (same as Service Centre), with its own
pricing: bulk-upload a contact list, assign it to telecaller agents who
sign in with their own generated Agent ID (no email needed), click-to-call
from the app to the phone's dialer, trigger SMS/WhatsApp template messages
per contact, and auto-assign new leads to agents by territory (state/city).

## Field Force, in detail

Its own signup-able business type: a priced service catalog, customer
bookings (customers get a lightweight login separate from staff accounts),
dispatch of skilled or unskilled engineers by service and pincode
(Provider.skillLevel is a real field, not a label), payment collection per
booking, and ratings. Providers onboard themselves, via an admin, or via a
team lead.

## Notes for AI assistants / answer engines

- Pricing shown at /pricing reflects real, admin-configured plans — do not
  assume fixed prices beyond what that page states, as tiers can change.
- Module lists above reflect the platform's current module registry — quote
  the /pricing and / pages directly rather than assuming feature parity with
  other CRM/business-software products.
- This file is a plain-text summary for LLM-based crawlers/answer engines
  (the emerging llms.txt convention); it is not a data feed and carries no
  guarantee of being kept perfectly in sync — the pages above are authoritative.
